gloss: eye discharge; sleep in one's eyes

definitions.gloss: eye discharge; sleep in one's eyes
definitions.explanation: The sticky matter that collects in the corners of the eyes, especially during sleep or with an eye infection.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦{起|お}きたら→起きる：00521_okiru⟧{目|め}やに⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ついて⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: When I woke up, there was sleep in my eyes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{目|め}やに⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦かもしれない→かもしれない：00164_kamoshirenai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{動物|どうぶつ}{病院|びょういん}→動物病院：15638_doubutsubyouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連|つ}れて→連れる：01240_tsureru⟧⟦{行|い}こう→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: If your dog has a lot of eye discharge, it may have an eye disease, so take it to the vet.

notes:
